note: The twelve quality gates of the Valice publishing factory. A gate is 'passed' only with evidence (a file path, URL or measurement) and an owner; scripts/factory/gate.mjs refuses anything else. Founder-owned gates cannot be passed by an agent.

gates.name: Market fit
gates.evidence: MARKET.md with a top-20 BSR sample (>=20 timestamped rows) and a go/no-go
gates.killCriterion: no competitor gap, or no measurable demand

gates.name: Rights
gates.evidence: RIGHTS.md + a row per source in valice-house/rights/ledger.csv with status GREEN and evidence URLs
gates.killCriterion: any RED, or a YELLOW without a written mitigation

gates.name: Originality / similarity
gates.evidence: QA/similarity.json from scripts/factory/similarity.mjs, overlap below threshold
gates.killCriterion: 8-gram overlap above the configured threshold with any Valice manuscript

gates.name: Content quality
gates.evidence: QA/draft-lint.json clean; usability pilot recorded for workbooks/puzzles
gates.killCriterion: below SPEC.md word/section budget; placeholder tokens; missing pilot

gates.name: Factual verification
gates.evidence: CLAIMS.jsonl with a verdict per claim from a verifier who is not the author; no WRONG remaining
gates.killCriterion: a load-bearing claim WRONG or UNVERIFIABLE and not cut

gates.name: Editorial
gates.killCriterion: house-style violations; a cut claim re-introduced

gates.name: Cover
gates.evidence: QA/cover-check.json clean for every cover slot in ASSETS/cover/
gates.killCriterion: thumbnail unreadable; wrong spine; <300 DPI; rights issue

gates.name: Interior / proof
gates.evidence: QA/preflight.json clean; KDP Previewer pass recorded; proof order id for a new trim/template
gates.killCriterion: fonts not embedded; missing glyphs; page count outside range; Previewer rejection

gates.name: Metadata
gates.evidence: QA/metadata-lint.json clean (subtitle counts equal measured counts; keyword rules)
gates.killCriterion: a claim in metadata that is not true of the book

gates.name: KDP compliance
gates.evidence: QA/compliance-lint.json clean — the sheet AND the built interior. kdp-linkage-lint on the registered PDFs finds no non-canonical host, no data-wall URL, no unauthorised biography, no broken PDF metadata and no false listing claim; and the COMPANION-LINKAGE REVIEW (checklist row 16, added 2026-09-03) confirms the address stands on a dedicated companion page carrying a code that is actually found in the raster, is at least 20% of the page height and 0.5mm per module, and decodes to the address it is meant to carry; AI disclosure answered in project_config.json
gates.killCriterion: undisclosed AI content; undifferentiated public domain; Select conflict; wrong ink; a printed address that is not valicepress.com; a companion that exists but is not printed; a companion printed as a mention rather than on a page of its own; a code that cannot be found on the page, is too small to scan, or decodes to the wrong address

gates.name: Website product QA
gates.evidence: validate:catalog output clean for the slug

gates.name: Founder publication approval
gates.evidence: the reviewed diff that sets websiteStatus: "published" (commit hash) and/or the KDP submission id
